headline: Zagros Renda real estate fund sells property portfolio for R$530m
summary: Zagros Renda (GGRC11) signed an agreement to sell 10 logistics properties to FII Suno Imóveis for R$530 million, projecting a profit of R$0.22 per share.
why: Real estate fund asset sales and portfolio restructuring directly impact share yields, net asset values, and liquidity in domestic property markets.
